d: Represent SharkNinja products in retail stores by engaging shoppers, demonstrating products and recommending solutions suited to their needs. The Brand Expert will help deliver a strong customer experience, support sales performance, and maintain excellent brand standards on the shop floor.
q: Previous experience in retail sales, product demonstration or customer service is preferred.
Experience selling small domestic appliances (SDA) is a plus.
Strong selling skills and the ability to explain product benefits clearly.
Confident and approachable, with the ability to engage different types of shoppers.
Good organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to prepare accurate reports.
Flexibility to work retail shifts, including weekends and public holidays, as required.
Fluent in English; Arabic or other languages are an advantage.
r: Welcome and engage shoppers, understand their needs, and recommend suitable SharkNinja products.
Demonstrate product features and benefits clearly and confidently.
Apply effective selling techniques to convert shopper interest into sales and support store targets.
Maintain strong product knowledge across Shark and Ninja categories, including new launches and promotions.
Keep product displays and demonstration areas clean, organised and aligned with brand guidelines.
Coordinate with retailer staff to support product availability, visibility and customer service.
Submit timely reports on sales, stock availability, shopper feedback, competitor activity and in-store issues.
Participate in product training, store activities and promotional events.
Follow retailer policies and represent SharkNinja professionally at all times.

d: As the Director of Revenue, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing the hotel's revenue strategies and pricing models. Your responsibilities include overseeing revenue management, forecasting, and pricing to maximize profitability and occupancy.
r: Develop and implement revenue management strategies to achieve revenue goals.
Analyze market trends, competitor pricing, and demand to make informed pricing decisions.
Monitor and manage room inventory and availability across distribution channels.
Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to drive revenue growth through promotions and campaigns.
Conduct regular revenue meetings to review pricing, demand forecasts, and market insights.
Utilize revenue management software and tools to optimize pricing and inventory.
Analyze historical data to identify patterns and trends for pricing and inventory control.
Forecast future demand and revenue based on market analysis and historical data.
Prepare and present revenue reports and performance metrics to senior management.
Develop and maintain relationships with distribution partners and online travel agencies.
Participate in budgeting and financial planning related to revenue.
Train and mentor revenue management team members.
Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in revenue management.
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly manner to safeguard the health and safety of guests and colleagues, as well as contribute to environmental conservation.
Adhere to the company’s environmental, health, and safety procedures and policies.

d: The Performance Senior Manager will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of HungerStation Market by providing management with the insights, analysis, and recommendations required to make better strategic and operational decisions.

The role will work closely with senior management and functions including Commercial, Operations, Finance, Logistics, Product, Marketing, and BI to monitor performance, identify opportunities, challenge plans, and translate insights into actions.
q: 7–10 years of relevant experience in performance management, strategy, management consulting, corporate finance, FP&A, business analytics, e-commerce, or technology.
Strong experience in business performance management, strategic planning, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and translate complex analysis into clear recommendations.
Experience in e-commerce, quick commerce, marketplaces, retail, or technology is preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, or another relevant field.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.
Ability to move between high-level strategy and detailed analytical work.
Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive ambiguous, cross-functional topics.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides.
Strong SQL skills is a strong plus; experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Looker are highly preferred.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
r: Own HungerStation Market performance reporting across financial, commercial, customer, and operational metrics.
Monitor performance, identify key drivers and gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Lead weekly and monthly business reviews, executive updates, and performance deep dives.
Support senior management with ad hoc analysis on critical business topics.
Lead business forecasting and support annual and strategic planning.
Drive OKR setting, tracking, and performance management.
Support P&L management and identify key revenue, cost, investment, and profitability drivers.
Build and challenge business cases and investment plans, including store expansion.
Lead deep dives across store, customer, commercial, operational, and logistics performance.
Analyze customer acquisition, frequency, retention, churn, and lifetime value.
Evaluate campaign, promotion, pricing, and investment performance.
Build analytical frameworks and models to improve business decision-making.
Support optimization of pricing and commercial mechanics, including fees, minimum order values, margins, and promotions.
Evaluate customer investment and trial strategies based on incremental impact and ROI.
Monitor competitive activity and translate market developments into business actions.
Support medium- and long-term strategy across store expansion, assortment growth, and new business opportunities.
Develop frameworks for pricing, assortment, customer lifetime value, and budget optimization.
Identify opportunities to improve demand planning, availability, and business performance through analytics and automation.
Act as a key business partner across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Logistics, Product, Marketing, and BI.
Translate business priorities into clear analytical, product, and operational requirements.
Drive alignment across local and Delivery Hero stakeholders and ensure initiatives progress against plan.
x: Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
